decisions.title: R-21-207: Menaul Redevelopment Study Adoption Resolution
decisions.description: The signed City Council resolution adopts the Menaul Redevelopment Study and Recommendations as current City policy, directs implementation funding through Council set-asides, the capital-improvement program, and State capital outlay, and formally precedes the 2023 Menaul MRA plan.
decisions.provenance_status: official City Legistar matter record and enacted attachment reviewed; signed original verified visually
processing_notes: Original official enacted resolution preserved without modification.
All three pages visually reviewed; the signature page records 9-0 Council adoption on November 3, 2021 and mayoral approval on November 12, 2021.
The separately attached 59-page study is an exact duplicate of canonical candidate src-657c1cd76dba9bce and is not being archived again.
